XDOCUMENTO.Titolo: Engine failure to start, various electrical faults and warning lights for different systems
XDOCUMENTO.InfoDoc: LIGHTING | ELECTRONICS | BODY | COMPUTER | B1010 | B1011 | B1017 | B1023 | B1028 | B1048 | B1057 | B1058 | P0504 | P181D | U0422 | U0426 | U1700 | LIGHTS | INDICATORS | LIGHTS | FAULT | ENGINE | MIL | START&STOP | AIRBAG | WINDOWS | BOOT | TAILGATE |

XCAPITOLO.Corpo:
Legend of the degree of reliability

* low level : Detection of the car repairer, case study of the fault not found by the manufacturer.

** medium level : Extensive fault history, found by service technicians and repairers.

*** high level : Certainty of the fault, good degree of "repetition" reported by the manufacturer.

• System: Electronics

  • Device: Body computer

  • Fault: The engine would not start and cut out suddenly whilst driving, followed by the four indicators flashing during the start-up attempt. The electric windows, indicators, tailgate and handbrake warning light failed to operate; the engine fault, airbag, general fault and Start&Stop warning lights came on.

  • Faults detected by the self-diagnostic system: One or more of the following:
    • B1010 (Brake pedal switch – Malfunction)
    • B1011 (Left rear brake light – Wiring fault)
    • B1017 (Door lock relay – Wiring fault)
    • B1023 (Number plate lights – Wiring fault)
    • B1028 (Rear right brake light - Wiring fault)
    • B1048 (CITY switch - Malfunction)
    • B1057 (Driver’s side window switch - Fault)
      B1058 (Passenger-side window switch – Fault)
    • P0504 (Brake switch 1-2 signal – Incorrect signal)
    • P181D (Gear lever position sensor – Neutral position: incorrect signal)
    • U0422 (Active suspension control unit – Data received, invalid)
    • U0426 (Auxiliary heater control module – Data received, invalid)
    • U1700 (CAN data bus – Body computer – Error, no communication)
  • Cause: Oxidised body computer connections

• Action: Check the status of the body computer connections and restore them if necessary
